items.statement: objective_control: The record-control procedure identifies quality, verification, project, and other records covered by the system.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Ovaj postupak primjenjuje se na zapise:

items.statement: objective_control: The procedure defines identification, collection, completion, storage, maintenance, and disposal of quality records.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Svrha ovog postupka je uspostaviti sustav zapisa kvalitete, zaštite okoliša, zdravlja i sigurnosti te definirati način njihove identifikacije, prikupljanja, popunjavanja, spremanja, održavanja i odlaganja.

items.statement: objective_control: The director is assigned responsibility for establishing and implementing the record-control system.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Direktor EKONERG-a ima odgovornost za uspostavljanje i provedbu sustava kontrole zapisa.

items.statement: supporting_control: The Q/EP/HS service lead is assigned record-generation, collection, storage, maintenance, and disposition duties.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Voditelj Q/EP/HS službe ima odgovornost za generiranje, prikupljanje, spremanje, održavanje i raspolaganje zapisima kvalitete koji se odnose na sustave kvalitete

items.statement: objective_control: Department directors are responsible for generating, collecting, storing, and keeping records from their work area and work orders.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Direktor odjela ima odgovornost za generiranje, prikupljanje, spremanje i čuvanje zapisa kvalitete

items.statement: objective_control: Verification documents receive identifiers that connect them to the verification and record year.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Izvještaji i ostala dokumentacija s provjere označavaju se brojem provjere i brojem zapisa, te godinom.

items.statement: objective_control: Verification records are generated by the verification team.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Zapise s provjere generira tim za provjeru

items.statement: supporting_control: Work-order records are collected, reviewed, approved, and identified by the team lead or lead verifier.

sources.source_locator: KONTROLA ZAPISA > 3. POSTUPAK > 3.3. Prikupljanje, pregled i odobrenje zapisa

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Zapise vezane uz radni nalog prikuplja, pregledava i odobrava Voditelj tima/Vodeći verifikator

items.statement: objective_control: Quality-system records are stored and retained according to the record schedules in the procedure.

sources.source_locator: KONTROLA ZAPISA > 3. POSTUPAK > 3.6. Spremanje i održavanje zapisa

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Zapisi sustava kvalitete se spremaju i čuvaju u skladu s Prilogom B ovog postupka.

items.statement: objective_control: Record retention time is tied to the work-order contract or the applicable procedure requirement.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Zapisi se u arhivi zapisa čuvaju u vremenu određenom ugovorom za svaki radni nalog odnosno prema zahtjevu pojedinog postupka.

items.statement: candidate_lead: The record schedule names an internal-audit report and its retention period; objective audit execution evidence must be checked.
candidate_lead: The record schedule includes original studies and elaborations; verify the related design review and approval trail.
